messages:
maya: Quick sync — we need to finalize the SKU consolidation + migration playbook by EOW. multiple add-ons and overlapping tiers are causing onboarding friction.
jonas: Can you spell out the minimal scope? engineering capacity is limited next quarter.
maya: Minimal = unify 6 legacy SKUs into 3 clear SKUs, deprecate 2 add-ons that are low usage, and create a migration tool for customers on contracts.
li: Sales: must keep grandfathering option for enterprise deals. we lose deals if we force churny re-quoting. recommend a 12mo grandfather window. :warning:
sophie: Finance: need a migration revenue model and P&L impact. can we model margin delta if we move 20% of users to new SKUs?
maya: Sophie — action: can you run a sensitivity table by Wed? key dimensions: migration rate, price lift, addon removal.
arya: CS: top 10 customers flagged. two are sensitive to per-token deltas, one will need an SOW for migration support. we should pilot with the least-risk two.
jonas: For the migration tool: estimate 2 sprint effort for export/import + billing mapping + rollback path. need clear acceptance criteria.
maya: Acceptance criteria (draft):
```
- migration tool can remap customer usage to new SKU with <1% token loss
- rollback path in <30 min to original billing config
- migration docs + contract amendment template completed
- pilot executed with 2 customers and no P0 incidents
- churn attributable to migration <1% over 90 days
```
li: Also need playbook lines for negotiated exceptions: seat-based vs token-based customers, and credits handling.
sophie: I'll model 3 scenarios and include ops cost for maintaining old SKUs vs immediate cutover.
maya: Decision needed on add-ons: keep "priority-routing" as paid addon, deprecate "per-call validation" and roll it into base for new SKUs (but keep as legacy addon for contracts).
jonas: rolling per-call into base increases runtime costs — we need a quantization/optimization mitigation tracked in the sprint.
maya: Good call, add to eng backlog: quantization profile to offset +2% token-cost delta.
arya: Customer comms draft: short FAQ, migration schedule, and dedicated support channel for pilot.
ops-bot: Deployment note: created #sku-migration-runbook, permissions set to product/eng/sales/cs.
li: Outcome we want to present to sales: clear migration timeline, grandfather window, credits policy, admin tool for partial rollbacks.
sophie: I'll share numbers Wed 3pm. if numbers look neutral we can propose a September pilot.
maya: Next steps: Sophie models by Wed; Jonas scoping migration tool by Thu; Li to identify 2 pilot accounts by Thu; Arya drafts comms. We'll reconvene Fri 10am to make final call. :calendar:
jonas: Ack — will post tech spec in the runbook channel once scoped.
maya: Thanks all — prioritize the acceptance criteria above when building the roadmap ticket.
li: +1, will prep negotiation scripts for enterprise discussions. :thumbsup:
